title: Prevalence of unruptured intracranial aneurysms according to comorbidities, risk factors, country, and time period: a systematic review and meta-analysis
title_zh: 根据合并症、危险因素、国家和时间段的未破裂颅内动脉瘤患病率：系统综述与荟萃分析
abstract: BACKGROUND: The incidence of aneurysmal subarachnoid haemorrhage declined between 1980 and 2010, which coincided with a decline in smoking and prevalence of hypertension. We aimed to investigate whether the decrease in subarachnoid haemorrhage incidence is paralleled by declines in unruptured intracranial aneurysm (UIA) prevalence. METHODS: For this systematic review and meta-analysis, we searched Embase, PubMed, and Web of Science for articles published in any language from Jan 1, 2011 to Dec 31, 2025, and reassessed 68 articles published before March 1, 2011 from a 2011 systematic review and meta-analysis. Articles were eligible for inclusion if they used a cross-sectional or case-control design and provided the crude number of participants and those with UIA. We only included studies reporting numbers of UIA separately from ruptured aneurysms and with ten or more patients. Summary data were independently extracted by JD with AZ or CB and conflicts were resolved by GJER. The primary outcome was proportion of participants with UIA. Relative to a hypothetical reference population (mean age 50 years, 50% women, and no comorbidities), age and/or sex-adjusted prevalence ratios (PRs) for regions, comorbidities, and risk ratios (RRs) for female sex, smoking, and hypertension were estimated using generalised linear mixed models. A time trend analysis was done by binomial meta regression using the mid-year of data acquisition. We assessed the certainty of evidence using GRADE. The study was registered with PROSPERO, number CRD420261296728. FINDINGS: Our search screened 4708 studies. 67 reassessed and 95 newly identified articles, reporting on 316 131 participants and 11 822 people with UIAs, were included in our meta-analysis. In the reference population, the estimated prevalence of UIAs was 3·9% (95% CI 3·0-5·1). The prevalence of UIAs in individuals with atherosclerosis was 5·5% (4·7-6·4; 2229 of 40970 participants) and the adjusted PR was 1·3 (95% CI 0·8-2·0) compared with the reference population. For positive family history of aneurysmal subarachnoid haemorrhage (aSAH) or UIA, the UIA prevalence was 7·9% (5·6-11·1; 412 of 4252 participants) and the adjusted PR was 2·4 (0·5-11·2). For connective-tissue disorder, the UIA prevalence was 10·3% (6·5-16·0; 94 of 879 participants) and the adjusted PR was 3·9 (2·0-7·6). For autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), the UIA prevalence was 12·8% (9·2-17·6; 293 of 1990 participants) and the adjusted PR was 4·4 (1·5-12·6). RRs were for current smoking 1·4 (1·2-1·6; 798 of 27911 participants), for having hypertension 1·6 (1·5-1·7, 4043 of 83053 participants), and for female sex 1·9 (1·8-2·0; 3415 of 65020 women and 2122 of 76130 men). In studies on healthy individuals with MR angiography or CT angiography as imaging modality, the prevalence in 2016-2022 was 6·6% (6·3-6·8; 2904 of 41191 participants). The adjusted PR was 1·8 (1·1-2·8) for 2016-2022 versus 2002-2015. Prevalence of UIAs of 5 mm or larger was 0·7% (0·6-0·8) in 2002-2015 and 1·4% (1·0-1·9) in 2016-2022. The UIA prevalence did not differ between countries. τ2 showed significant heterogeneity between studies. The certainty of the evidence ranged from very low to moderate. INTERPRETATION: Prevalence of UIA is increasing, particularly over the past two decades. This increase is only in part explained by improved detection of small UIAs and an ageing population, and other factors-such as environmental-are likely involved. Alongside patients with ADPKD and a positive family history of aSAH, patients with connective-tissue disorders had a higher prevalence of UIA than the reference population. Our findings warrant further investigation into the potential benefit of personalised screening and management strategies in groups at high risk for having UIAs. FUNDING: None.
abstract_zh: 背景：1980年至2010年间，动脉瘤性蛛网膜下腔出血的发病率下降，这与吸烟率和高血压患病率的下降相吻合。我们旨在探讨蛛网膜下腔出血发病率下降是否伴随未破裂颅内动脉瘤（UIA）患病率的下降。方法：本系统综述与荟萃分析检索了Embase、PubMed和Web of Science，纳入2011年1月1日至2025年12月31日任何语言发表的文章，并重新评估了2011年3月1日前发表的68篇文章。符合条件的研究采用横断面或病例对照设计，并提供了参与者总数及UIA人数。仅纳入将UIA与破裂动脉瘤分开报告且样本量≥10的研究。数据由JD与AZ或CB独立提取，冲突由GJER解决。主要结局为UIA参与者比例。相对于假设参考人群（平均年龄50岁，女性50%，无合并症），使用广义线性混合模型估计地区、合并症的年龄/性别调整患病率比（PR）以及女性、吸烟和高血压的风险比（RR）。时间趋势分析采用二项式荟萃回归，以数据获取中点年份为基准。使用GRADE评估证据质量。研究已在PROSPERO注册（编号CRD420261296728）。结果：检索共筛选4708篇研究，重新评估67篇并新增95篇，共计316,131名参与者，其中11,822人患有UIA，纳入荟萃分析。参考人群中UIA估计患病率为3.9%（95% CI 3.0-5.1）。动脉粥样硬化患者中UIA患病率为5.5%（4.7-6.4；40970人中2229人），调整后的PR为1.3（95% CI 0.8-2.0）。有动脉瘤性蛛网膜下腔出血或UIA家族史者UIA患病率为7.9%（5.6-11.1；4252人中412人），调整后PR为2.4（0.5-11.2）。结缔组织疾病者UIA患病率为10.3%（6.5-16.0；879人中94人），调整后PR为3.9（2.0-7.6）。常染色体显性多囊肾病（ADPKD）者UIA患病率为12.8%（9.2-17.6；1990人中293人），调整后PR为4.4（1.5-12.6）。RR分别为：吸烟者1.4（1.2-1.6；27911人中798人），高血压者1.6（1.5-1.7；83053人中4043人），女性1.9（1.8-2.0；65020名女性中3415人，76130名男性中2122人）。在使用MR血管造影或CT血管造影的健康人群研究中，2016-2022年的患病率为6.6%（6.3-6.8；41191人中2904人），调整后PR为1.8（1.1-2.8）与2002-2015年相比。5毫米或以上的UIA患病率为2002-2015年0.7%（0.6-0.8），2016-2022年1.4%（1.0-1.9）。UIA患病率在不同国家间无显著差异。τ²显示研究间存在显著异质性。证据质量从非常低到中等不等。结论：UIA患病率正在上升，尤其在过去二十年。此增长仅部分可归因于对小型UIA检测的改进和人口老龄化，其他因素（如环境）也可能起作用。与ADPKD患者和有动脉瘤性蛛网膜下腔出血家族史的患者相比，结缔组织疾病患者的UIA患病率更高。我们的发现提示需要进一步研究针对高风险群体的个体化筛查和管理策略。资金：无。
